RESULT [continual]: LoRA configurations reach 0.7138 mAP50-95 on YOLO11s (full fine-tuning 0.6428) and 0.7307 on YOLO12s (full fine-tuning 0.6662). Peak training memory drops about 44%, but training takes about 72% longer.
US [continual]: This is the most direct evidence that LoRA on YOLO can work at all. The repo's tools/lora_yolo.py puts LoRA only on head convs with a frozen backbone and neck, a placement this paper says needs care. It is a single, very recent, unreplicated paper. Treat it as a candidate arm to test, not a settled answer. Its mergeable adapters would make 'roll back an increment' as simple as dropping an adapter.
CORRECTION [continual]: arXiv submission dated 2026-08-07. LoRA reaches 0.7138 on YOLO11s vs 0.6428 full FT, and 0.7307 on YOLO12s vs 0.6662. Peak memory is 43.9% lower and training takes 1.72x as long. It is a preprint only, with no venue.
